description:
Search the SYNTHETIC demo inventory (about 860 fictional vehicles at 20 fictional dealers in TX, CA, FL, GA, AZ,
IL, NY and OH). Results are not real vehicles for sale; say so when you show them.
Each result has listing_id (dealer_key:VIN), vehicle basics, headline_price (before tax, title and fees), dealer_name,
and selling_location: the store that holds the unit, with address and phone. link_status is linked, or ambiguous
when the listing does not say which of the dealer's stores holds it (see selling_location_candidates). A unit can
be held at a sister store run by another dealer in the same group; operated_by_dealer_id then differs from dealer_id.
Matching is exact on vocabularies, so a total of 0 often means a wrong value: check the parameter descriptions,
widen radius_miles or drop a filter; a zero total also returns hints.
The named parameters are shortcuts. filters reaches every other attribute: for example
{"field": "canonical.vin", "op": "eq", "value": "<VIN>"} finds a VIN, {"field": "price_summary.doc_fee", "op": "range",
"max": 300}, {"field": "incentives[].label_raw", "op": "eq", "value": "Military Appreciation"}.
Payment search: payment_max / payment_min filter on a DEMO monthly finance estimate computed per listing from its
itemized out-the-door estimate (tax, title, registration, dealer fees) for the buyer location, minus down payment and
trade equity, at a demo APR by credit tier unless apr is given. Each result then has estimated_payment (rounded to
$5, with a range) and dealer_advertised_payment when the listing shows one; the response has payment_assumptions
and a one-line assumptions_summary to read back to the shopper. For 'under $300/month' pass max_monthly_payment=300.
With a cap, near_misses lists up to 3 cars just above it, and a zero result returns to_reach_target (extra down
payment, or a 72 or 84 month term). To compare scenarios for one car, use compare_payment_scenarios.
Every result has estimated_out_the_door (exact, same as estimate_out_the_door for the buyer location), availability
(status, price_valid_until, last_updated, observed_at), seating_capacity, third_row and cargo_capacity_cu_ft
(synthetic demo specs). sort=best_value score = 0.35 * cost_score + 0.30 * age_score + 0.35 * mileage_score
(formula in best_value_formula). A zero result with zip returns coverage: nearest_store, nearest_new_inventory and
nearest_qualifying_inventory with distance, match count and lowest out the door, plus a coverage_note.
estimated_out_the_door on results and near_misses carries the same warnings and excluded_items (for example an
optional add-on's name and price) that estimate_out_the_door returns. Each result has dealer_segment / dealer_type,
third_row_type and sliding_doors. With payment inputs, estimated_payment has financing_eligibility, credit_tier and
credit_tier_source (default when not given), negative_equity_rolled_in, loan_to_value_pct and warnings; the response
has financing_summary. Pass financeable_only=true to drop listings the demo financing rules flag.
Estimate, not an offer; dealer sets price, lender sets rate. Not penny-accurate.

FieldFilter.description: One generic filter on any ontology field (see list_searchable_fields).

field.description: Dotted field path from list_searchable_fields, e.g. canonical.exterior_color.family, price_summary.doc_fee, incentives[].label_raw, store.name, payment.estimated_monthly. Shortcut names such as make, model, color, price, state also work.
field.title: Field

op.description: eq exact (case-insensitive text); any_of with values; contains (text substring); range with min and/or max (numbers or ISO dates, inclusive); bool with value true/false; exists.
op.title: Op

value.description: Value for eq, contains, bool or exists.
value.title: Value

FieldFilter.title: FieldFilter

PaymentScenario.description: One what-if finance scenario. Omitted fields use the call's defaults ($0 down, 60 months, good credit).

cash.description: True to price paying cash: no loan or interest; omit apr, term_months, credit_tier and down_payment.
cash.title: Cash

credit_tier.description: Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted. Credit tiers (demo APR new / used): excellent about 720 and up (6.0% / 8.5%); good about 660 to 719 (7.5% / 11.0%); fair about 620 to 659 (11.5% / 16.0%); poor below about 620 (15.5% / 20.0%).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives the buyer qualifies for.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity if allowance and payoff are unknown; no tax credit.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the state's trade-in tax credit).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

PaymentScenario.title: PaymentScenario

apr.description: APR percent for payment estimates. If omitted, a demo APR by credit_tier is used.
apr.title: Apr

best_value_needs.description: With sort=best_value, shopper needs that also score: seats, cargo, full_third_row, sliding_doors, low_mileage, newer, budget_headroom (needs max_out_the_door). Score = 0.70 x base + 0.30 x mean need score; ranking_rationale shows each part.
best_value_needs.title: Best Value Needs

body_style.description: suv, sedan, pickup, hatchback, minivan or wagon. Use pickup for trucks.
body_style.title: Body Style

buyer_city.description: Buyer's city for payment tax lines.
buyer_city.title: Buyer City

buyer_county.description: Buyer's county (without 'County') for payment tax lines.
buyer_county.title: Buyer County

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for payment tax and fees. Default: the selling store's state.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's ZIP; fills any missing buyer state, county and city. If no buyer location is given, zip is used, then the selling store (see out_the_door_assumptions.buyer).
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

city.description: Exact city of the selling store (for example Houston, Katy, Plano). Suburbs are separate cities, so for 'in or near a city' prefer zip plus radius_miles.
city.title: City

condition.description: new, used or cpo (certified pre-owned). used also returns cpo units.
condition.title: Condition

credit_tier.description: excellent, good (default), fair or poor; picks the demo APR when apr is omitted. Credit tiers (demo APR new / used): excellent about 720 and up (6.0% / 8.5%); good about 660 to 719 (7.5% / 11.0%); fair about 620 to 659 (11.5% / 16.0%); poor below about 620 (15.5% / 20.0%).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

dealer_key.description: Dealer key from list_dealers, e.g. lonemesa.
dealer_key.title: Dealer Key

dealer_segment.description: franchise, independent_used or bhph (buy-here-pay-here). Each result shows dealer_segment and dealer_type.
dealer_segment.title: Dealer Segment

down_payment.description: Cash down in USD for payment estimates. Default 0.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives the buyer says they qualify for; applied to payment estimates where a listing offers them. Off by default.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

exterior_color.description: Exterior color family: white, black, silver, gray, blue, red, green or bronze.
exterior_color.title: Exterior Color

filters.description: Generic filters on ANY ontology field (vehicle, listing, store, dealer, price, fee, incentive, media, payment). All filters must match. See list_searchable_fields.
filters.title: Filters

financeable_only.description: True to drop listings whose payment estimate fails the demo financing rules (minimum amount financed, max term by age and mileage) at these terms. Recommended with max_monthly_payment; financing_summary counts what was dropped.
financeable_only.title: Financeable Only

fuel_type.description: gasoline, hybrid, plug_in_hybrid or electric. Use electric for EV or BEV.
fuel_type.title: Fuel Type

include_near_misses.description: With a payment cap, also return up to 3 listings within $25 above it in near_misses, flagged above_target. Default true.
include_near_misses.title: Include Near Misses

include_payment.description: True to add estimated_payment to every result without filtering on it.
include_payment.title: Include Payment

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Each result is about 2 KB; 5 to 10 is usually enough.
limit.title: Limit

make.description: Make, case-insensitive, e.g. Honda, Ford, Tesla. 14 makes are present.
make.title: Make

max_monthly_payment.description: Canonical monthly payment cap: the shopper's monthly budget in USD, e.g. 300 for 'under $300/month' (demo estimate).
max_monthly_payment.title: Max Monthly Payment

max_out_the_door.description: Maximum estimated out-the-door total in USD for the buyer location (tax, title, registration, dealer fees, minus trade). Exact, unrounded, and the same figure estimate_out_the_door returns for the same inputs.
max_out_the_door.title: Max Out The Door

min_out_the_door.description: Minimum estimated out-the-door total in USD (same basis as max_out_the_door).
min_out_the_door.title: Min Out The Door

model.description: Model with its punctuation, case-insensitive: CR-V, F-150, Model 3, Mustang Mach-E.
model.title: Model

payment_max.description: DEPRECATED alias of max_monthly_payment (still accepted; the lower wins if both are given).
payment_max.title: Payment Max

payment_min.description: Minimum estimated monthly finance payment in USD (demo estimate).
payment_min.title: Payment Min

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

price_max.description: Maximum headline price in USD (before tax, title and dealer fees). For a budget that includes taxes and fees, check estimate_out_the_door.
price_max.title: Price Max

price_min.description: Minimum headline price in USD (before tax, title and dealer fees).
price_min.title: Price Min

scenarios.description: Optional what-if finance scenarios (up to 6). Each returned listing gets payment_scenarios with payment, amount financed, total interest and total cost per scenario. Filter and sort still use the main inputs.
scenarios.title: Scenarios

seating_min.description: Minimum seats, e.g. 7 for a third row family vehicle (synthetic demo spec).
seating_min.title: Seating Min

sort.description: price_asc (default), price_desc, year_desc, mileage_asc, distance_asc (needs zip), payment_asc, payment_desc, otd_asc (estimated out the door) or best_value (documented score over out-the-door cost, age and mileage; each result gets ranking_rationale).
sort.title: Sort

state.description: Two-letter code of the selling store's state: TX, CA, FL, GA, AZ, IL, NY or OH. Not the full name.
state.title: State

term_months.description: Loan term in months, 12 to 96. Default 60.
term_months.title: Term Months

third_row.description: True for third row seating only, false to exclude it (synthetic demo spec).
third_row.title: Third Row

third_row_type.description: full (adult-usable, car-seat capable) or compact (small, occasional; e.g. Tiguan). Demo spec.
third_row_type.title: Third Row Type

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity in USD if allowance and payoff are unknown (negative for upside-down); no tax credit is applied for it.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the trade-in tax credit where the state allows it).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

trim.description: Trim name, e.g. LX, EX-L, Lariat.
trim.title: Trim

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP of the shopper. With radius_miles, filters by straight-line distance to the selling store and adds distance_miles to each result.
zip.title: Zip

name: search_inventory
